title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
description: A martial-arts loving panda gets help from his mentor and friends as he becomes a warrior and protects the valley where he lives.

episodes.title: S2-E13The Spirit Orbs of Master Ding
S2-E20The Secret Museum of Kung Fu
S2-E23Mama Told Me Not to Kung Fu

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x1
episodes_data.description: Po and Monkey race to find a sacred orchid to cure a sick Tigress. But Monkey is hypnotized by the evil Scorpion into hunting down another target -- Po.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x2
episodes_data.description: Po is put in charge of protecting the Emperor’s daughter while on a diplomatic trip to visit the Qidan clan. Luckily, Tigress and Mantis are along for the journey.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x3
episodes_data.description: Po destroys the training hall whilst cleaning it and needs to repair it quickly before Shifu finds out. He seeks out the builder of the hall, Taotie, who holds a grudge against Shifu.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x4
episodes_data.description: While transporting an important column, Po and Tigress’s attempt to defend it against bandits is complicated when they are chained together.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x5
episodes_data.description: Po learns a new move by jumping ahead of reading fifty sacred scrolls and ends up wiping the memories of the Furious Five.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x6
episodes_data.description: Po is tricked into saving the leader of the Croc Bandits’ brother when in fact he has kidnapped the son of a powerful landowner.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x7
episodes_data.description: Mantis gets help from Po after receiving word his ex-fiancée needs help, which he is reluctant to take as his hometown believes Mantis to be the Dragon Warrior.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x8
episodes_data.description: Po goes undercover as a prisoner in Chor Ghom Prison to learn where a diabolical criminal has hidden the ultra-dangerous weapon, the Sacred War Hammer of Lei Lang.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x9
episodes_data.description: The Furious Five discover that Po has incredible kung fu abilities far beyond anyone else’s in the group. This worries them as they believe he will turn evil like Fenghuang, a member of the Furious Five before the current team who was also greatly powerful.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x10
episodes_data.description: Po has split himself into two opposing parts by looking through the Mystic Mirror of Yin and Yang and needs to stop his duplicate from destroying his reputation and friendships with his bad personality traits.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x11
episodes_data.description: When a villainous rival of Master Shifu manipulates Po into breaking an important rule, the consequences allow him to become Grand Master of the Jade Palace.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x12
episodes_data.description: Hundun, a former guard at Chor Ghom prison, wants revenge against the Dragon Warrior for making him lose everything in his life as a result of defeating Tai Lung.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x13
episodes_data.description: Shifu invites Mr. Ping to stay at the Jade Palace when his noodle shop is badly damaged during a fight between Po, Monkey and three pig brothers. This causes tension between him and the others until he is asked to leave and is subsequently captured by the pig brothers believing him to be Master Shifu.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x14
episodes_data.description: Po encounters the ghost of Master Oogway, who seems strangely bent on causing dissension in the Jade Palace.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x15
episodes_data.description: When a kung fu prodigy arrives at the Jade Palace, Po’s enthusiasm begins to sour when he gets a little jealous of the attention being heaped onto the young master.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x16
episodes_data.description: Po befriends a troupe of dancers, unaware that they are actually a band of traveling thieves. When a prized item goes missing from the Jade Palace, Po has to disguise himself to infiltrate the band.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x17
episodes_data.description: Po must look after Taotie's son after he is taken to prison after a failed attack on the Jade Palace. His loyalties are split when he tries to help his father get out of prison though he has warmed to Po.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x18
episodes_data.description: Po finds he has a fan club in the valley but they are unimpressed when they find the Dragon Warrior's day to day life isn't as action packed as they imagined. With this newfound attention flagging, Po releases a demon in order to fight it and impress his fan club.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x19
episodes_data.description: It's Dragon Warrior Challenge Day, and if anyone can defeat Po in battle before sundown, they will become the Dragon Warrior.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x20
episodes_data.description: Shifu's personal hero arrives at the Jade Palace, but in his overenthusiasm, Shifu accidentally lets him run amok while Temutai schemes to abduct him.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x21
episodes_data.description: When the Furious Five go out of town and the Jade Palace is attacked, Po has to rely on a team of elderly Mahjong players for back-up.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x22
episodes_data.description: Po's kung fu hero comes to town for an exhibition match.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x23
episodes_data.description: Po sets up his father, Mr. Ping, on a series of unsuccessful dates, only to find out Mr. Ping already has a girlfriend. Po's happiness for his dad is short lived when he finds out the mystery lady's identity.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x24
episodes_data.description: Po needs to find an awesome Dragon Warrior trophy for the Hall of Heroes or be humiliated in front of the entire village at the upcoming Warrior Festival.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x25
episodes_data.description: When Shifu's con-man father comes back into town, Po finds himself in the middle.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 1x26
episodes_data.description: The villagers are outraged over a rash of thefts in the Valley of Peace.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x1
episodes_data.description: Tigress must babysit a child who has been separated from his parents. The Croc Bandits are trying to kidnap him for a ransom.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x2
episodes_data.description: Master Shifu and the Furious Five meet their newest trainee – The Emperor's Grandson!

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x3
episodes_data.description: While visiting a famous war hero named General Tsin, Po discovers that the retired general has lost his mind.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x4
episodes_data.description: Po comes face to face with hopping ghosts called Jiang Shi which have been sighted around the Valley of Peace's cemetery.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x5
episodes_data.description: Po buys shoes that promise to make him better at Kung Fu without the training, but the shoes were created with evil magic and threaten the Furious Five.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x6
episodes_data.description: After being defeated by Po, Taotie has a nervous breakdown.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x7
episodes_data.description: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu. Part 1 of 2.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x8
episodes_data.description: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu. Part 2 of 2.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x9
episodes_data.description: Po's the only one unhappy when Peng returns to town, because Po knows who Peng's uncle is.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x10
episodes_data.description: Po takes a job as a bounty hunter to earn money to buy his father a gift.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x11
episodes_data.description: Po must sit in as master of the Jade Palace when Shifu hurts his back.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x12
episodes_data.description: Fung finds an old scroll with instructions for making living terra cotta warriors, and soon it's up to Po and the Furious Five to stop his monstrous clay creations.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x13
episodes_data.description: When Po is possessed by the ghost of the evil Master Ding, it's up to Tigress to save him before Ding can unleash his powers and enslave the Valley of Peace.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x14
episodes_data.description: Po and Mantis visit the equivalent of an ancient Chinese Comic-Con, where Po’s fanboy enthusiasm gets out of hand.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x15
episodes_data.description: Po is sad when he learns that everyone has been invited to a dinner party except for him, due to his poor table manners. Will Shifu be able to teach Po proper etiquette AND foil the attack of the evil Temutai and his army?

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x16
episodes_data.description: When kung fu is outlawed, Po turns to donning a mask to fight crime.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x17
episodes_data.description: Po and Tigress must track down and stop a messenger from delivering a scroll that could thrust China into all-out war!

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x18
episodes_data.description: When Master Mugan from the Garnet Palace decides she needs a new Kung Fu Master, Tigress volunteers. Will the Furious Five be minus one or will Po convince Tigress to return to the Jade Palace?

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x19
episodes_data.description: Po tries to help Crane get his "mojo" back after he is humiliated at a charity event.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x20
episodes_data.description: With Po and the Furious Five at each other's throats, Shifu takes them all on a disastrous road trip.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x21
episodes_data.description: Po saves a girl from some bandits, only to learn that she's engaged to be married to the Dragon Warrior.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x22
episodes_data.description: Master Chao visits the valley to oversee a Tournament. Shifu is convinced that Po and Master Chao want to replace him. Shifu's old enemy, Pai Mei, arrives in the middle of the tournament and threatens to destroy Shifu.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x23
episodes_data.description: When Crane's mother visits the Valley of Peace, Crane asks his friends to help him keep a secret from her.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x24
episodes_data.description: Po plays a prank on Monkey with a fake love letter and their relationship is tested.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x25
episodes_data.description: After his father takes him on a wild goose chase, Po becomes embarrassed.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 2x26
episodes_data.description: Mantis ingests a growth potion that makes him huge and inadvertently puts himself and his friends in danger.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x1
episodes_data.description: When Shifu's thieving ex-girlfriend visits the Jade Palace seeking redemption, Shifu quickly learns she wants more than simple forgiveness.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x2
episodes_data.description: Hundun opens up a noodle shop in the village, threatening to put Mr. Ping out of business.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x3
episodes_data.description: Po and Mr. Ping must make things right when two Croc Bandits have a spat.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x4
episodes_data.description: Po is struck by lightning which gives him the power to read minds.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x5
episodes_data.description: Master Yao announces that anyone who brings him a new wonder will be allowed to ask him a single question.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x6
episodes_data.description: Despite Po's objections, Shifu calls in a samurai prawn to help take down a villain from Japan.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x7
episodes_data.description: Shifu suggests that Po should take a vow of silence to help with his focus.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x8
episodes_data.description: The villagers begin to adopt an anti-snake sentiment when Fu-xi turns renegade and attacks the Valley of Peace.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x9
episodes_data.description: The local thugs love Mr. Ping's soup so much, the noodle shop becomes a villain hangout.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x10
episodes_data.description: Po befriends a group of orphans who have been stealing money and goods from the villagers.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x11
episodes_data.description: Fed up with his constant complaining, Shifu puts lazy Po in charge of training the Furious Five. Things go from bad to worse when the Croc Bandits receive training from a mysterious kung fu master and become the new heroes of the Valley of Peace.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x12
episodes_data.description: Po is suspicious when Shifu gets back together with his evil ex-girlfriend, Mei Ling.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x13
episodes_data.description: Shifu sends Po to shut down an underground fight club.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x14
episodes_data.description: Po and the Five must stop food-stealing rats to end a famine, but Po's weakness for food may hinder the mission.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x15
episodes_data.description: Po discovers the seeds of Shuyong: magical items that can actually take the user back in time. After Po disobeys Shifu, evil Fenghuang steals one of the seeds, putting the entire world in danger.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x16
episodes_data.description: Po's qi is out of balance, and Shifu and wise Master Lun attempt to re-harmonize the panda using the ancient tradition of musical kung fu.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x17
episodes_data.description: Mystic secrets are stolen from Master Yao's head, so the master turns to Po for help.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x18
episodes_data.description: Po and Monkey discover a small village and meet an impostor claiming to be the Dragon Warrior.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x19
episodes_data.description: Bian Zao steals magical lightning powers.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x20
episodes_data.description: The furious five quit the Jade Palace and head out on their own.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x21
episodes_data.description: Po is left with amnesia after a blow to the head.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x22
episodes_data.description: Shifu and Mr. Ping compete for Po's attention.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x23
episodes_data.description: Zeng unhappily quits his job at the Palace.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x24
episodes_data.description: Po hosts a reunion for the First Furious Five, and Shifu's heroic legacy is questioned at the gathering.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x25
episodes_data.description: General Tsin has a conspiracy theory about alien rice weevils taking over the world.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x26
Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x27
episodes_data.description: Po becomes head of Imperial Security when Lu Kang returns. Part 1 of 2.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness 3x28
episodes_data.description: Po becomes head of Imperial Security when Lu Kang returns. Part 2 of 2.
